title: LS-MDRC-002 Sealed Holdout Fixture Manifest
description: Sealed holdout fixtures for LS-MDRC-002. These fixtures must not be opened, scored, or used for rubric calibration until explicitly authorized. Lifecycle: SEALED → OPENED → CONSUMED. CONSUMED → SEALED is prohibited.

holdout_fixtures.title: Contradiction plus novelty distractor
holdout_fixtures.description_sealed: Contains an explicit contradiction embedded in a corpus with high-novelty distractors that may draw the instrument toward a false positive.
holdout_fixtures.sealed_note: File is committed but must not be scored before OPENED authorization.
holdout_fixtures.opening_condition: Explicit written authorization from a designated adjudicator separate from the construction role.
holdout_fixtures.non_claim: HO-001 does not represent the expected correct Lens Shift conclusion.

holdout_fixtures.title: Competing hypotheses with discriminating falsifier
holdout_fixtures.description_sealed: Two competing hypotheses about a claim; one has a specified falsifier. Tests whether the instrument identifies the discriminating evidence and applies it.
holdout_fixtures.sealed_note: File is committed but must not be scored before OPENED authorization.
holdout_fixtures.opening_condition: Explicit written authorization from a designated adjudicator separate from the construction role.
holdout_fixtures.non_claim: HO-002 does not establish that either hypothesis is correct.

holdout_fixtures.title: Required legitimate retraction
holdout_fixtures.description_sealed: A trajectory that requires a REVISE step; tests whether the instrument accepts legitimate retraction without penalizing V score.
holdout_fixtures.sealed_note: File is committed but must not be scored before OPENED authorization.
holdout_fixtures.opening_condition: Explicit written authorization from a designated adjudicator separate from the construction role.
holdout_fixtures.non_claim: HO-003 does not assert that retraction is a protocol failure.

lifecycle_invariant: CONSUMED → SEALED is prohibited. A failed holdout must be recorded in the evidence record of this instrument version. The instrument must not be modified to pass a holdout retroactively.
